requirements.other_qualifications: A Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related fields with minimum CGPA 2.75; or CGPA 2.50-2.75 subject to rigorous internal assessment; or minimum CGPA 2.50 in Accounting/Non-Accounting with 5 years relevant work experience or prerequisite courses; or equivalent qualification; or APEL-A certification from MQA.
